title: FALSE CLAIM: dooz '23,472 px = visual proof' (SUPERSEDED)
statement: The S72-W3/W4 claim that dooz rendered 23,472 px of real content is FALSE: S73 proved those are pure-black pixels forming an engine-default (0,0)-(489,47) region, byte-identical to the no-Activity Stopwatch frame (0e334abe1b10b592). Dooz visual proof remains UNRESOLVED. Determinism facts stand; the INTERPRETATION was corrected.
superseded_by: LAW-F145 + dated reclassification comment on issue #14 + S73_REPORT §5
notes: PRESERVED as an evidence-quality lesson (taskbook §68): pixel count != semantic visual proof. Never delete; mark SUPERSEDED and link the correction.
